sourceTitle: Combined Statement of Receipts, Outlays, and Balances of the United States Government for Fiscal Year 2025, Department of the Treasury

items.label: Earned Income Tax Credit — refundable excess
items.budgetTreatment: Mandatory outlay: payment exceeding the household's positive income-tax liability.

items.label: Child Tax Credit — refundable excess (ACTC)
items.budgetTreatment: Mandatory outlay: payment exceeding the household's positive income-tax liability.

accountingNote: The nonrefundable and liability-offset portions reduce individual income tax receipts and are already embedded in the simulator's FY2025 receipts target. Only the refundable excess recorded as an outlay is an additional automatic fiscal saving when individual income taxation is replaced.
